revisionDesc.change: Finalized - This is good to go.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Corrections checked on photo.

Submit - The first editor of this papyrus acknowledged that the 'a', which is clearly visible in col. 1 line 5 (and, by analogy, also present in the lacuna at col. 2, l. 4), was probably an abbreviation for a(sses). Because she viewed this as the equivalent of obols she printed (obols) in the text, and this was then entered in papyri.info. However, because the papyrus has 'a', I believe we must print a(sses) in the text, no matter what we make of currency matters in Egypt at the time. I've therefore changed the text.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine. Do not use capitals in lines 1 of each column.
